name: Dockmesh
free_limit: Free AGPL-3.0 self-hosted Docker Compose fleet manager; all features included with no paid edition, node limit, or license key. Supports multi-host agents, backups, RBAC, SSO and audit logs; hosting resources are not included.
watch_out: Requires user-provided Linux Docker hosts, storage and network. Project is pre-1.0 (v0.5.3 at verification); evaluate release maturity, security and backups before production. AGPL-3.0 network-use/source-sharing obligations apply to modifications; no free hosted VPS or managed service is included.
